body: [text sequence] outputs the lines of a text in order. With -g, lines go to the receive name given by their first element; otherwise they go out the left outlet. With -w, lines starting with a number (or a given symbol) are waits: a bang outputs everything up to the next wait, and 'auto' plays the sequence automatically. 'line' sets the current line and 'step' outputs the next one.
